premises.text: Websites need backup and monitoring to protect against unwanted changes
premises.evidence_span: if anything happens to your site, whether it was wanted or unwanted, that you want to revert, you can do it with just one button

premises.text: CodeGuard uses FTP or SFTP to back up websites
premises.evidence_span: Right now we use FTP or SFTP

premises.text: CodeGuard monitors website code for changes and takes snapshots
premises.evidence_span: we monitor your code for changes, either every hour or every day

premises.text: Users can configure monitoring frequency and actions on changes
premises.evidence_span: I can choose here whether I want to have it monitor daily, hourly, or never

premises.text: CodeGuard provides a simple way to revert changes to a website
premises.evidence_span: if it notices anything is different, I want it to repair by pushing the last version

premises.text: CodeGuard is built upon Git, a leading source version control tool
premises.evidence_span: Our system is built upon Git, developed by Linus Torvalds

value.text: Website protection is accessible and easy to use for everyone
value.evidence_span: we consider ourselves website protection for the rest of us

notes: Public beta spots and promotional code are excluded as traction.
